# Agentic Rigg 1.5.4 · build 29

The graphics card is back on the RGB page, and you can switch freely between colours and effects.

## New

- **2D and 3D card.** The RGB lighting page shows the graphics card again, in 2D or 3D. Choose the view with the toggle on the page, or under *Settings › Appearance › 3D card* (Auto, Always 3D or Always 2D). The card follows the real lighting controls:
  - it previews the colour, brightness and effect you choose,
  - it shows the colour last read from the card.

  There is one set of controls and one lighting zone, because the card has a single physical zone. The 3D resources are freed when you leave the page.
- **Switch between effects.** Switch directly between static colour, off, breathing, rainbow and colour cycle. This works while an effect is running and after you have kept a colour. Every switch is a new trial with **Keep** and **Roll back**. When **Apply** is disabled, the reason is shown below the button.

## Updating the RGB helper

The RGB helper uses a new protocol (3), and the oldest compatible RGB helper build is now 29. After updating the app, card lighting shows as needing an update. Press **Enable card lighting…** and enter your password once. In that one step the app:
- turns off the old RGB access, keeping the light and the saved starting point,
- installs and verifies this release,
- turns GPU control back on for the same card,
- enables the new RGB helper.

The GPU control helper and its protocol are unchanged, and working GPU control is not shown as outdated.

## Security

- **Before switching from an effect,** the helper reads the card and compares it with the last frame it wrote:
  - If the colour was changed outside the app, nothing is written and automatic restore is locked.
  - If the card cannot be read, the effect stops and the card returns to the saved starting point.
- **The saved starting point** (baseline) and the recovery journal never change during a switch.
- **The installer** reads existing permissions before any network access. It stops if a permission belongs to another user or is not owned by root. An unresolved RGB session stops the update before anything is replaced.

## Platform and installation

The target platform is **Ubuntu 26.04 · amd64 · GTK ≥ 4.22 · glibc ≥ 2.39**. System libraries are not bundled. Download the archive and `SHA256SUMS` into the same folder, then run:

```sh
sha256sum --check SHA256SUMS
tar -xzf agentic-rigg-1.5.4-build29-ubuntu26.04-amd64.tar.gz
cd agentic-rigg-1.5.4
./install.sh --bin-dir "$PWD/bin"
~/.local/bin/agentic-rigg
```

Run this as your normal user. Your settings and history are kept.

## Verification and limits

- **Automated checks:**
  - Clippy is clean, and the workspace tests pass.
  - The translation catalogs are complete in all ten languages.
  - Python tests without network or root cover the update path: old RGB access is turned off first, GPU control is restored, and a foreign or unsafe permission stops the install before any network access.
- **Simulated card:** the full switching flow (static → kept → breathing → rainbow → colour cycle → off → release) was run against a simulated card in an isolated GNOME session.
- **Rolling back** a switch made from an effect returns to the last effect frame, not to the effect itself.
- **Not yet run on real hardware:**
  - the effects and effect switching,
  - the RGB helper update through the app.
